messages:
Maria (PM): ACME signed. They need private pilot w/ HSM and a p95 SLA. Staging target = EoQ.
Ajay (Runtime Eng): HSM + p95 in private stack is doable but needs infra slot + runtime tuning.
Kevin (Infra): We only have two prewarm slots; both earmarked for Beacon. We can reassign one but Beacon will need a workaround.
Maria (PM): Can ACME accept a staged canary (10% -> 50% -> 100%) to buy us time?
Elaine (Security): HSM attestation + light pen test required. Expect ~10 business days for attestation/config and ~5 days for pen test after infra up.
Ajay (Runtime Eng): Runtime tasks: HSM plugin config, KV prefix cache enablement, quantization checks, hosted-fallback. I can deliver playbook & fallback in 2 sprints if infra slot confirmed.
Kevin (Infra): If we transfer a prewarm slot we can provision VPC peering and NATs in ~7 days. Need Maria to confirm by EOD Tue.
Maria (PM): I'll negotiate with Beacon PM. Proposed gating for canary: attestation complete, pen test no critical findings, canary metrics OK (error_rate <0.5%, p95 within SLA).
Ajay (Runtime Eng): Agreed. Will include tracing + token-level telemetry + prompt set regressions in playbook. Canary snippet I plan to use: ```yaml
canary:
  - percent: 10
    duration: 48h
  - percent: 50
    duration: 72h
rollback_on:
  - error_rate_pct: 0.5
  - p95_latency_delta_pct: 15
```
Kevin (Infra): I'll prep infra template once slot decision is made. Network checklist: KMS endpoints, HSM routing, NAT sizing.
Elaine (Security): Ping me when infra is ready; I'll schedule attestation and pen test windows.
ops-bot: Reminder: please add "ACME private pilot" to launch-lane board. Template: /boards/launch-lane/ACME-private-pilot.
Maria (PM): Action items: (1) Maria -> confirm slot transfer by EOD Tue; (2) Kevin -> infra template after confirmation; (3) Ajay -> rollout playbook + telemetry by next Wed; (4) Elaine -> book security checks. Flagging as customer-driven high priority.
Ajay (Runtime Eng): One runtime note: enable KV prefix cache early during canary to stabilize p95.
Maria (PM): Thanks — will post follow-up with Beacon thread link. :thumbsup:
